growthPlantSupport.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one Gredice gardening operation icon as a square true transparent-alpha cutout. Image 1 is the final Gredice Dekapitacija style reference. Match its warm top-left key light, slightly raised three-quarter angle, chunky beveled low-poly shapes, broad matte facets, warm amber accents, saturated leafy greens and deep ochre soil. Use the same strong depth and contrast. Center one tight near-square group at generous margins for subsequent export. Keep the defining action legible at 48px.
Operation: Postavljanje potpornja i vezanje, installing a stake and attaching an established tomato plant at its first tie. Show a fresh honey-ochre chunky wooden garden stake planted firmly into one compact earth clump right next to a sturdy tall tomato stem with three or four big green lobed leaves. At middle height, the stem and stake are held close by exactly one prominent chunky pale sage garden tie in a loose figure-eight wrap. All other parts of the wood are visible and empty. Put a small but unmistakable warm amber head wooden stake mallet leaned at the foot, visibly loose and to the right, to convey the stake has just been installed. Compose it as a single broad near-square planted scene, the soil visible with its characteristic brown facets and the leaves sweeping sideways. No fruit, old or multiple ties, or tool in midair.
Use real transparency around every component. No lettering, numerals, panel, pictogram arrow, motion streaks, person, fingers, backdrop, watermark, distant shadows or tiny props.
growthPlantSupport.export: Center the illustration on a transparent 640 × 640 canvas with 14% padding per edge on the longest axis. Encode as WebP at quality 90.
